run.question: What collections exist in the database? Then look at the transactions collection and tell me the verification code for the failed transaction.

report.summary: The configured MongoDB database shopdb holds three collections: customers, products and transactions (observed at query time 2026-11-23T18:48:01Z). The transactions collection has 9 fields per its inferred schema, including status, failure_reason, order_id and verification_code; it has an estimated 5 documents and a sorted read returned all 5. Exactly one of those five documents has status "failed": order_id ORD-10443 (customer C-203, credit_card, amount 324, created_at 2025-11-03T09:45:00, failure_reason "payment gateway timeout"), and its verification_code value as stored is "HMNG-227-k7x2p9". The other four documents are status pending (ORD-10445) or completed (ORD-10444, ORD-10442, ORD-10441). This is a data lookup, not a fault diagnosis: no root cause is named, and the value should be treated as sensitive credential-like data (a verification/one-time code) rather than as incident telemetry. Note that the documents' created_at timestamps (2025-11-01 to 2025-11-05) precede the authorized window, which starts 2026-10-24, so the read shows current stored state, not state during that window.
